entities.summary: Kevin Reginald Westgarth is a Canadian former professional ice hockey forward who played five seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Los Angeles Kings, Carolina Hurricanes, and Calgary Flames. Westgarth mainly played as an enforcer, as evidenced by his NHL career statistics of only 16 points and 266 penalty minutes in 169 games.
